reviews.text: We had a great experience with Celebrity. Mike helped us design our backyard oasis and Alex had the crews lined up and ready to go. From ground breaking to filling the pool was 1 month and 2 days. They finished in November 2022 and we had someone in the water every month the first year. We really had wonderful times and lots of swimmers from April through September. Best investment we have made to our new home.
reviews.author: Leslie Sharp

reviews.text: We have built 3 pools in different places in TX. This is the best pool company we have ever worked with! From the first meeting with Mike Segars who helped us through sales and design process. He ensured we felt comfortable and within budget. Also, the owner Marshall brought a level of expertise and professionalism that is rare these days. He is extremely trustworthy and stands behind his company's work. Lastly, the construction process was handled beautifully with Alex as our Project Manager. He was detail oriented, kept the project on time, gave on the spot suggestions and just an overall great person. I highly recommend Celebrity Pools if you are looking to sleep well at night that your in good hands with your pool / spa construction.
reviews.author: Paul Alfano

reviews.text:
We called Celebrity pools in a bit of a panic, with a seemingly impossibly short timeline to not only get our pool designed and built, but also to do so alongside our home being under construction. Mike and Alex and the whole team were incredibly accommodating and responsive to every communication, question and request.
I grew up around the pool business, so was highly critical of every phase. Each time, the workmanship of Celebrity Pools exceeded expectations, and met our timeline.
I highly recommend!!
(Photo of the pool is current state of completed pool, but still a work in progress for the surroundings!)
reviews.author: Cindy Rosser

reviews.text: Great experience with experts in the business! Timelines met when weather permitted. All crews came in ready to work and cleaned up after work day done. Every detail discussed and done with precision. Recommendations made elevated the whole project making it cohesive and stunning. Mike knows his business and can make your dream pool happen!
reviews.author: Michelle Charge

reviews.text: Mike, Alex and the team at Celebrity were excellent.  They were very professional and helpful in the design of our pool, hot tub and water feature that we wanted in our pool.  I would recommend them to anyone, great job team!  My family has already enjoyed the hot tub and can't wait to get in the pool this summer.  RD
reviews.author: Robbie Dewberry

reviews.text: We had more than 5 companies bid our pool and Celebrity gave us the most bang for our buck, hands down!  There were cheaper companies out there, but you basically only got a hole with some tile.  Celebrity took the time to walk us through maintenance and advise us on upkeep.  During the freeze, every one of my neighbors pools seemed to have issues, but mine came out just fine thanks to higher quality materials and professional installation!  Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Joshua Morrison

reviews.text: Marshall Barton and his colleague , Alex Espinal exceeded our expectations by building a pool we absolutely love. Their crews showed up on time, built what they were supposed to, and charged us a fair price. Grandkids visited last weekend and had a great time. We built a saltwater pool and we are delighted with it.
reviews.author: A. David Holland

reviews.text:
We had Celebrity Pools design and build a custom lap pool, enclosed by a screened in porch.

Design was a bit tricky because we wanted the screen to attach to our existing screen in porch. The pool was complete in 6 weeks, the screen room took a bit longer.

Also, there was a drainage issue, since the pool would occupy an existing drainage stream. This was designed and appears that the solution will work.
.
We have had everything including the screen room complete as of a few weeks ago.

Celebrity Pools has a dedicated construction crew with a responsive foreman. Plus Marshall and Mike will answer your questions in a very short turn around time.

Bottom line, if you want a pool done correctly in a reasonable timeframe, the I highly recommend Celebrity Pools!
reviews.author: Lois Perrine
